title: Diana Pasulka's turn while writing her book

tellings.quote: Uh, and then all of a sudden the second half of that book is like she goes down the rabbit hole herself and it's like, "Oh my god, I think there's something extremely real."

plain: A professor at the University of North Carolina Wilmington named Diana Pasulka is said to have changed her mind while writing a book: she began as an outside scholar, but in the second half she "goes down the rabbit hole herself" and comes to think "there's something extremely real". Michels tells this from his own reading of the book, which the record names as Heaven Can Wait, as a sign that even careful academics can be won over.
